UNI Burn Value Tops $1M for First Time as Robinhood Chain Activity Surges

According to Wu Blockchain Data Center, the value of UNI burned on September 4 reached $1.15 million, surpassing $1 million in a single day for the first time. A total of 184k UNI was burned, the second-highest daily amount on record, with Robinhood Chain accounting for 150k UNI. The surge was primarily driven by heightened trading activity on Robinhood Chain. On the same day, Robinhood Chain’s daily DEX volume exceeded $3 billion for the first time, with Uniswap accounting for as much as 98% of the total. — link

Spot Bitcoin ETFs Take In $175M; Ethereum ETFs Record $26.46M Inflow

According to SoSoValue, U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded $175 million in net inflows on September 4 (ET), marking their third consecutive day of inflows. BlackRock's IBIT led with $117 million, followed by Fidelity's FBTC with $57.22 million. Spot Ethereum ETFs saw $26.46 million in net inflows. BlackRock's ETHA and ETHB recorded $57.79 million and $16.44 million in inflows, respectively, while Fidelity's FETH posted $48.30 million in net outflows. — link

Qiao Wang: My Personal Crypto Portfolio Holds Only Bitcoin and Zcash

On August 29, 2026, Alliance DAO Founding Partner Qiao Wang said on the Steady Lads Podcast that his personal crypto portfolio currently consists only of Bitcoin and Zcash, as he prefers to keep his holdings simple. In dollar terms, stocks account for around 70%–80% of his portfolio, while crypto represents roughly 20%–30%. On a risk-adjusted basis, however, his Zcash exposure is comparable to—and may even exceed—his entire stock portfolio.

Tom Lee-Managed GRNY ETF Makes MSTR Its Largest Holding Ahead of 46% Rally

Bloomberg ETF analyst Eric Balchunas said the Fundstrat Granny Shots US Large Cap ETF (GRNY), managed by BitMine Chairman Tom Lee, sharply increased its position in Strategy (MSTR) starting in mid-August, taking MSTR from the fund’s smallest holding to its largest in roughly two weeks. As of September 3, MSTR accounted for about 3.02% of the portfolio, surpassing Robinhood at 2.99%. Balchunas noted that the accumulation took place before MSTR subsequently rallied about 46%. — link

National Sheriffs’ Association Drops Opposition to CLARITY Act Ahead of Senate Vote

According to Semafor, the National Sheriffs’ Association is changing its position on the CLARITY Act from opposition to neutral after months of warning that the bill could make it harder to prosecute illicit finance. The shift removes a key law-enforcement objection ahead of a Senate vote expected later this month, though broader disputes, including restrictions on presidential crypto-related profits, remain unresolved. — link

Trezor Shipping Provider Breach Expands, Exposing Data of 67,000 More U.S. Customers

Hardware wallet maker Trezor said the data breach at its shipping provider ShipMonk has expanded to affect another 67,000 U.S. customers, who placed orders between November 2019 and August 2021. Exposed data included names, email addresses, phone numbers, shipping addresses and order numbers. Trezor said ShipMonk had repeatedly confirmed the data had been deleted, but it remained in its systems. Trezor’s own systems were not compromised, and users’ devices remain secure. — link
